note: Acknowledged `ready` -> lesser state transitions, read by `bun run check:oracle` (issue #2696). An entry lets ONE card leave the compiled pool in ONE change; once that change lands on the base branch the entry matches nothing and should be deleted. Every entry names its disposition: `trackedBy` (the issue that undoes the loss) or `intended: true` (a deliberate drop). Written by `bun run oracle:mark-regressions --acknowledge`; stale entries are pruned after merge by `oracle:prune-regressions`, never by a PR author (issue #6061).
